name: doochyweb
description: Web dashboard for managing cTrader accounts

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:test
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:test && vite build
scripts.test: tsx --test test/market.test.ts test/breakouts.test.ts test/breakoutEngine.test.ts test/analogues.test.ts test/narration.test.ts test/narrationModel.test.ts test/scraperRules.test.ts test/scraperRunner.test.ts test/scraperReplay.test.ts test/twelveData.test.ts
